slides.headline: HERE TO [[PLAY]]. NOT TO PROVE.
slides.body: What actually happens in a Good Noise room.

slides.headline: NO [[JUDGEMENT]].
slides.body: We embrace mistakes. That's where the good stuff comes from.

slides.headline: NO [[HIERARCHY]].
slides.body: Nobody's here to perform, prove themselves or hit a benchmark.

slides.headline: NO [[PRESSURE]].
slides.body: Share when you're ready. Not a moment before.

slides.headline: EVERY MUSO'S ON [[EQUAL]] FOOTING.
slides.sub: Beginner or gun — same room, same rules.
